source_title: How Does It Work To Be A Domestika Instructor Ea17Bd468726
snippet_primary: "I launched a Domestika course last month, here are the questions I've been asked by people wanting to be instructors 👩🏻‍🏫... I didn't pitch, but I have subsequently launched two people successfully since I was accepted. So YES you can pitch (and I would try to pitch anything in life)... Domestika is focused on all aspects of creativity, and its audience is typically creative entrepreneurs. I wouldn't worry if you have a non-traditionally creative topic, but I would ensure that your brand and audience match. Read: the stuffy corporate look is out."
